He is a QA and Operations Intern at The RxAssistant, where he builds and tests AI-powered solutions for pharmaceutical clients, and previously a Research and Development Intern at Westpepper Capital, where he built machine-learning backtesting pipelines and real-time crypto market-data systems. His own projects run from clinical computer vision to systems programming in C. His website is served from a Jetson Orin Nano on his desk, which also runs the language model visitors can talk to.

roles.title: QA and Operations Intern
roles.summary: Develops and deploys AI-powered solutions for pharmaceutical clients across more than ten brands: client-facing conversational-AI prototypes and production demos, ambient listening and workflow automation, conversational AI over regulated product, access, affordability and patient-support content. Assists QA and UAT for client releases (authored and executed 100+ test cases, validated AI responses, supported deployments from staging through production). Contributes to product infrastructure including React Native setup and AWS Bedrock integration.

roles.title: Research and Development Intern
roles.summary: Built an end-to-end machine-learning modeling and backtesting pipeline over earnings, guidance and analyst-estimate data (15 model variants, up to 57% next-day direction accuracy in historical tests). Designed and deployed real-time crypto order-book tracking in Java on AWS EC2 via the Kraken API across 200+ markets. Developed trading strategies, one promoted to production. Built a Python analytics pipeline and dashboard (P&L and volume aggregation, Matplotlib) used daily.

projects.name: Savor
projects.summary: An AI pantry application built over one weekend at HenHacks 2026 with three teammates. It reads a grocery receipt with Google Gemini's vision model, keeps the inventory in Supabase, suggests meals around whatever is closest to expiring, and totals the money and carbon saved. Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind, deployed on DigitalOcean. https://devpost.com/software/savor-jby10r

projects.name: Two-stage dog pose cascade
projects.summary: Predicts 39 body keypoints and 46 dog-face landmarks from video. DeepLabCut's published SuperAnimal-Quadruped checkpoint runs frozen to find the body and head; a face box derived by the same function used in training crops to 256x256; a second model trained on DogFLW reads the face. Against the previous unified model on 479 held-out images, mean NME fell 28.6% and PCK@5% rose from 71.0% to 84.1%. https://github.com/gabe-udel/dog-emotions

projects.name: Dog gait CCL classifier
projects.summary: A pipeline that takes a lateral video of a dog walking, runs pose estimation over it, and classifies cranial cruciate ligament injury against normal using a random forest trained on 12 GB of clinical video. Writes a pose-overlaid copy of the input so the prediction can be checked by eye. https://github.com/gabe-udel/cisc-442-final

projects.name: gabevandevere.com
projects.summary: This site: hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no framework, served by Caddy from an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano at home behind an outbound-only Cloudflare Tunnel, with a Python proxy in front of a locally running open language model (llama.cpp) that visitors can chat with. One command builds, smoke-tests both locally and live, and deploys. https://github.com/gabe-vand/personal-site

projects.name: Oracle
projects.summary: A Java plugin for a Paper Minecraft server running on a Raspberry Pi 4B. It reads all public chat with no command or prefix, scores every line 0-100 for whether it is worth answering, and speaks only when a line clears the threshold and it is off cooldown. It notices deaths, advancements and slower behavioural patterns, and swaps between Claude, Gemini and the local Jetson model without a restart.

projects.name: The World Cup polynomials
projects.summary: Counting the ways n teams in a round-robin tournament can all finish with exactly r goals for and r goals against, which is the Ehrhart polynomial of the zero-diagonal face of the Birkhoff polytope. Doron Zeilberger posed it as a DIMACS challenge in June 2026 having reached n = 6; computed and verified for n = 7 (degree 29) and n = 8 (degree 41) by inclusion-exclusion on the diagonal.

projects.name: A neural network in C
projects.summary: MNIST digit recognition written from scratch in C with no machine-learning library: the network trains in Python, the weights are dumped as flat binary, and a C program loads them for inference behind an SDL2 canvas you can draw a digit into. https://github.com/gabe-vand/digit-recognition-c

projects.name: Automated short-form video pipeline
projects.summary: Python pipeline that scrapes source material, writes a script, narrates it, generates word-timed subtitles with whisper, renders with MoviePy, pydub and ffmpeg, and uploads via the YouTube Data API, fully eliminating manual content creation. https://github.com/gabe-vand/content-models

projects.name: pimon
projects.summary: A single self-compiling C file that charts a Raspberry Pi's SoC temperature, CPU and memory usage in the terminal. No ncurses and no runtime: metric files are opened once and re-read with pread(), the process blocks in poll() between samples, and it makes no allocations after startup, staying around 600 KB resident.
